description: This file contains implementation code for container management within the WPEFramework, including classes and methods for container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and status querying, as well as singleton access patterns and logging initialization.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Administrator class for managing container instances, providing singleton access and container creation.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance, providing methods for lifecycle management such as start, stop, and status checks.

methods.name: IContainerAdministrator::Instance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the container administrator instance.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in specified search paths.

methods.name: CRunContainer::CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes container context and logging.

methods.name: CRunContainer::~CRunContainer
methods.description: Destructor that stops the container if running and removes it from the administrator.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the running container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information for the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information for the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container (not implemented, returns nullptr).

methods.name: CRunContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces the container's process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover container instances that may exist from previous runs.
